name: Boilers and pressure vessels
payer: Insurer employs the inspector; owner pays the insurer.
access: On-site inspection during fabrication and in service.
publication: Stamps and certificates public; inspection reports to insurer and jurisdiction.
ai_analogue: The one regime that removed the owner-pays conflict by routing inspection through insurers with skin in the game. The current AI insurance-backed certification proposals are this model.

milestones.event: Hartford Steam Boiler founded: insurance conditioned on inspection.
Grover Shoe Factory boiler explosion kills 58.
Massachusetts enacts the first state boiler law.
National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors commissions inspectors across jurisdictions.
